prompt: With weeder1, look at plant_7 with its camera. If the detector is less than 90 percent confident that it is a weed, tell channel "ops" which row it is in and do not move to it.
why: The confidence of a detection is not a measured kind (temperature, mass, distance, label), and labels are exact: a program cannot test how sure the camera is (language reference: 'Measured values').
